hold_reasoning: No order clears the bar today. PRICE FLAG: Goldfinger's thesis rests on 'EUR-gold at its 117.28 high', but the verified 4GLD.DE close is 113.84 (2026-07-30), 2.9% below the level cited; World's own confirm line (gold clears 117.19 in EUR) agrees the breakout has not printed. The USD gold record is real (GC=F 4150.30) but the EUR add-tell is not, so I do not front-run it. Nor can I park a conditional for it: the metals theme is already my largest at 562.82 EUR (4GLD.DE 296.64 + PHAG.L 266.18) = 29.6% of a 1901 EUR book, the per-position cap leaves 4GLD.DE only ~103 EUR of headroom, and a 100 EUR top-up carries a 2.50 EUR IBIE round-trip (2.5%) that needs a 5%+ move before PFU 30% to be worth doing. Routing the add through SGLN.MI to sidestep the cap would take metals to 43% of the book, which I veto on theme concentration. The binding constraint is cash: the already-parked ACX.MC trigger commits 13.729 x 18.55 = 254.67 EUR the moment it fires, leaving 177.15 against a 150 EUR floor, so free capital is ~27 EUR, not 282. Monsieur Forex (7/10) is unconfirmed on my own prices (USDCHF 0.8195 vs 0.8205 required, USDCAD 1.4106 vs 1.4125) and unlevered spot FX returns rounding errors for a whole slot at this book size. Sharp Shooter USD's CPAY is unhedged USD equity into a tape its own author calls broken (20- and 50-day lost on the heaviest volume in fifty sessions, 318 of 500 declining) - World's 'a EUR book loses twice' applies directly. Eight of ten analysts sit at hold or reduce. No risk-budget breach exists: largest line AIR.PA 311.92, under the 400 cap. NVDA is the one genuinely broken thesis (Yolo Sapiens USD now calls the AI anchor finished at the leadership level, 190.01 heading toward their 183 invalidation), but the position is EUR 0.44 and the IBIE 1.25 EUR order floor is 284% of the proceeds - paying 1.25 to recover 0.44 destroys capital to delete a rounding error that carries no economic risk, so it is swept on the next session I am already transacting. For risk-budget purposes the book runs five economic positions plus one dust line, so ACX.MC firing takes it to six, inside the cap. Watch levels for next session: 4GLD.DE close above 117.28 with DXY under 101 (gold add-tell), PHAG.L below the gold/silver 71.5 line with silver failing 55.40 (silver exit), AIR.PA 208.40 shelf, BTC-EUR box floor 50.8k, ALV.DE against the European risk-off break.
